zh.boardAria: 设置位置支持范围决策图
zh.onePreferenceBody: 放进宿主通用设置中的一行。
zh.sectionSeatBody: 注册为宿主设置窗口中的一个分区。
zh.windowOnly: 必须使用插件独立窗口
zh.noPublicSeatBody: 不要把宿主设置入口或 shell.overlay 当成窗口 API。
zh.sourceNote: 依据 data/slots.json：settings.trigger 与 settings.launcher 属于宿主入口；shell.overlay 是浮层座位。

en.boardAria: Decision map: where a settings surface can live
en.onePreferenceBody: Put it in one row in the host's General settings.
en.sectionSeat: A few groups of related plugin settings
en.sectionSeatBody: Register it as a section in the host's settings window.
en.noPublicSeatBody: Don't treat the host's settings entry points or shell.overlay as a window API.
en.sourceNote: Source: data/slots.json — settings.trigger and settings.launcher are host entry points; shell.overlay is an overlay seat.
